description: Change stock quantity of a product or its options. For a product WITHOUT options pass channelProductNo + stockQuantity; for a product WITH options pass originProductNo + options[]. 상품/옵션 재고를 변경합니다. IRREVERSIBLE: changes the live store. Needs channelProductNo (no-option) or originProductNo (option product); both come from naver_list_products.

channelProductNo.description: Channel product number — required for a product without options

confirm_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: the tool then only returns a preview and a token. Show the preview to the user, and only after they agree call again with exactly the same arguments plus this token. 처음엔 비워 두세요. 미리보기를 사용자에게 보여주고 동의를 받은 뒤, 같은 인자에 이 토큰을 넣어 다시 호출합니다.

options.description: Per-option stock for products with options

originProductNo.description: Origin product number — required for a product with options

stockQuantity.description: New stock for a product without options

name: naver_update_stock
